episodes.title: How I Ended Up In A Cult | Part 1
episodes.description:
If you don’t take anything away from this video take this: 

1. Everything happens for a reason

2. Your testimony is someone’s saving grace

3. VET everything and everyone. 

Never thought I’d publicly share this story but I know it’s necessary in order to bring awareness to the topic and prevention. 

This is day 2 of posting for 100 days and I’m not holding back. Sharing my testimonies with a purpose to help and glorify the one who kept me through it all 🙌🏽

If this resonates with you please subscribe and follow me on this journey.
